card.name: Tapering and dose-change instructions
card.fires_on: The space or small word just before a dose amount in instructions for lowering, tapering or switching a dose, e.g. "no more than" or "decreased gradually". Also some spots inside drug names in dosing-change sections.

modes.label: Space before taper amount
modes.description: The blank before a number in a step-down limit such as "no more than" or "a maximum of".
modes.example: Reduce the dosage by no more than<< >>0.5 mg every three days.

modes.label: Linking word in discontinuation text
modes.description: A small word like be, the or dose in a sentence about gradually decreasing or stopping a drug.
modes.example: Dosage of deflazacort oral suspension must<< be>> decreased gradually if the drug has been administered

modes.label: Inside drug name in dose tables
modes.description: A piece of a drug name in dose-reduction or switching text.
modes.example: Patients treated with memantine<< hydro>>chloride tablets may be switched to mem
